tags.title: Tags to watch
tags.description: Stack Overflow tag slugs. Example: python, react, postgresql, vector-database, langchain. Find any tag slug in the URL of its tag page. Leave empty if using searchQueries instead.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Full text queries against Stack Overflow titles and bodies. Example: vector database alternative, langchain memory leak. Leave empty if only using tags.

keywords.title: Keywords (client side filter)
keywords.description: Only questions whose title or body contains any of these keywords are kept. Case insensitive. Leave empty to keep everything the tag or query returned.

site.title: Stack Exchange site
site.description: The Stack Exchange site to query. stackoverflow covers programming. Other popular sites: serverfault, superuser, dba, askubuntu, datascience, ai.stackexchange, devops.stackexchange.

sortBy.title: Sort
sortBy.description: creation orders by newest first. activity orders by last activity (new answers, edits). votes orders by score. relevance is for search queries.

maxAgeHours.title: Max age in hours
maxAgeHours.description: Skip questions older than this many hours. Applied locally after API returns results. 0 keeps everything.

minScore.title: Minimum score
minScore.description: Skip questions with a score below this. Zero score is the default state for brand new questions. Negative is for downvoted ones.

onlyUnanswered.title: Unanswered questions only
onlyUnanswered.description: Keep only questions with zero answers. Strong lead gen signal for devtool founders since these are open intent.

onlyNoAcceptedAnswer.title: No accepted answer only
onlyNoAcceptedAnswer.description: Keep only questions that have not yet accepted an answer. Includes questions with answers that did not resolve the asker's issue.

includeBody.title: Include question body
includeBody.description: Pull the full question body with formatting stripped. Turn off to save dataset space if you only need titles and tags.

maxQuestionsPerSource.title: Max questions per tag or query
maxQuestionsPerSource.description: Per source cap. Stack Exchange API returns up to 100 per page, the actor paginates until this cap or the end of results.

maxQuestionsTotal.title: Maximum questions per run
maxQuestionsTotal.description: Hard cap on questions pushed to the dataset per run. Controls cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip question IDs already pushed on previous runs. IDs are stored in the key value store under SEEN_IDS. Turn off to return every match on every run.

apiKey.title: Stack Exchange API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Without a key you get 300 API calls per day. With a free key from stackapps.com/apps/oauth/register you get 10,000 per day. Leave blank if your schedule fits under 300 calls.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. The Stack Exchange API is public and rate friendly, a proxy is only needed if you are running many actors from one IP.
